content2.content: In Flutter, notifications are a way to send data up the widget tree. This is different from system notifications.

content4.content: You can extend the `Notification` class to create custom events.

content7.content: Wrap a widget subtree in `NotificationListener` to catch notifications bubbling up from its descendants.

content10.content: This mechanism is used internally by scrollables (`ScrollNotification`) and can be useful for custom widget communication.
